Day 27 (old art) - March 2016 (age 13)

sooo it's not easter, but this was another self portrait!

I owned this exact sweater and the only reason I still remember it is because of this drawing!

this was a time where I did a lot of self portraits (and didn't draw the whites of the eyes for some reason? lol) and I think it was partially me being burnt out and not wanting to challenge myself - that's totally okay btw!

if you don't have the energy for more mentally taxing art, no need to force it

but of course if you NEVER challenge yourself, improvement is much slower

for young-me this created a cycle where I would be disappointed at the lack of improvement and either work harder or quit completely for a few months and the cycle of burnout and frustration just kept going and going

this is why I'm so adamant about art being about your own enjoyment of it, I don't wanna repeat the cycle and end up quitting again •3•;
